root_cause.text: The `x25_sock.fraglen` variable could overflow when accumulating packet lengths because no bounds check was performed before addition, and it was not reset when the fragment queue was purged.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (x25->fraglen + skb->len > USHRT_MAX) return 1;` in `x25_queue_rx_frame()` to prevent overflow, and sets `x25->fraglen = 0;` in `x25_clear_queues()` to ensure the variable is reset when the fragment queue is cleared.
